_policy: Every consciously deferred piece of work gets a row: what was deferred, why, what enforcement exists meanwhile, and a review-by date. `cargo xtask deferrals --check` (weekly scheduled CI) fails once a row passes its date un-re-decided — a deferral nobody re-examines is a silent forever. Re-deciding means either building the thing (delete the row) or re-dating it with a fresh reason in the same commit. Decisions intended to be permanent do not belong here; they get ADRs.

deferrals.what: The pinned suite's auth/* client scenarios (OAuth metadata discovery, registration, PKCE flows) as host-SUT gates. Re-decided 2026-09-24 with the project review's D4: the HTTP-observable authorization clauses (401 with WWW-Authenticate, protected-resource metadata) enter the validator's registry (review item 2.8); a full OAuth client in the reference host stays out
deferrals.why: A full OAuth client is a large build whose only consumer would be the host-as-SUT gate; the trace validator gets the observable half without it
deferrals.meanwhile: TRAN-009 documented exclusion until item 2.8 lands; the four protocol client scenarios gate in CI

deferrals.what: Re-decided 2026-09-24: WITHDRAW the everything-server adoption offer (rust-sdk#902). The drafted withdrawal comment is docs/reports/rust-sdk-902-withdrawal-draft.md; posting it is the owner's action. Once posted: delete this row, close issue #9 with the outcome, and mark backlog item 1 closed.
deferrals.why: The premise is gone. rust-sdk runs its own in-repo conformance server against the official suite on every push for both 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28 and reports 100% (30/30) on both (register 3.10, verified 2026-09-24 at rust-sdk 6677eee). #902 has had no maintainer engagement in 105 days: the rendered issue page on 2026-09-24 shows it open, labelled P2/enhancement, no assignee, no linked PR and no visible comment. The 2026-08-24 search-index signal of one comment was not reproduced by the page; a hidden or deleted comment would explain both readings. Our server stays as this project's calibration subject and fixture generator, which needs no upstream adoption.
deferrals.meanwhile: Risk R9 and issue #9 carry the state; nothing is posted upstream without the owner

deferrals.what: Re-decided 2026-08-18, the review-by having passed on 2026-08-15. HALF OF THIS ROW IS NOW BUILT: the draft ratchet DRAFT_SUITE_VERSION moved 0.2.0-alpha.9 → 0.2.0-alpha.11 with a BLESS=1 re-measurement and a scenario diff review in the same commit. What remains deferred is the STABLE pin only — xtask's SUITE_VERSION (0.1.16, the 2025-11-25 gate) — which bumps when a stable 0.2.0 exists, refreshing both expected-failures baselines and the agreement divergence ledger in the same change. The two pins are no longer coupled: 03-conformance-strategy now states their separate triggers, because holding a pre-release ratchet back does not keep its measurement stable, it makes it describe an older question
deferrals.why: There is still nothing stable to bump SUITE_VERSION to: npm `latest` is 0.1.16, published 2026-03-30 and unchanged for four and a half months (re-fetched 2026-08-18). Pin bumps are deliberate PRs with a scenario diff review (03-conformance-strategy §Official-suite version policy). The previous revision of this row claimed the alpha dist-tag had been 'quiet since 2026-07-01'; that was false by the next day — alpha.10 published 2026-07-27 and alpha.11 on 2026-08-07 — which is why this row no longer predicts upstream quiet and states only what was observed
deferrals.meanwhile: As of 2026-08-18 the watch is a gate, not a date: `cargo xtask suite-currency` (weekly, in `claims-expire`) fails the moment npm's `latest` stops being 0.1.16, and a red weekly run now files a tracking issue — so the stable release that triggers this row announces itself rather than waiting to be noticed. The weekly suite-alpha job still runs the alpha dist-tag non-blocking at the registry's revision; the draft ratchet pins alpha.11 and gates every check's status; conformance#338's fix arrives with the stable bump and its agreement-divergence entry will go stale loudly
